Change in the value of a hedged block after a mortality shock

Source: R/hedge.R
block_change.Rd

Change in the value of a hedged block after a mortality shock

Usage

block_change(
  m,
  n_ins,
  n_ann,
  s,
  x_ins = 40,
  x_ann = 65,
  S = 250000,
  B = 20000,
  i = 0.045
)

Arguments

m

A mortality object from mortality_law().

n_ins

Number of insurance policies.

n_ann

Number of annuities.

s

Relative mortality shock.

x_ins

Age of the insured lives.

x_ann

Age of the annuitants.

S

Insurance benefit.

B

Annual annuity payment.

i

Effective annual interest rate.

Value

The change in the total value of the promises (positive means the insurer owes more).
